name: Anmitsu
description: A classic Japanese dessert bowl of agar jelly cubes, red bean paste, mochi, and fruit drizzled with kuromitsu syrup.
ingredients: a pinch of white sesame seeds
a handful of fresh shiso leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with neutral vegetable oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the soba noodles and shichimi togarashi until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the toasted sesame oil with the water until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 10 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with mitsuba or a dusting of mirin.
Slice or portion into servings and serve.
tips: This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
